name: qrank
title: QRank — ranking of Wikidata items
description: Wikidata items ranked by their aggregated pageviews across Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Wikibooks and other Wikimedia projects over the past 52 weeks.

resources.name: qrank
resources.title: QRank
resources.description: Wikidata items sorted by decreasing QRank, which is the number of pageviews over the past 52 weeks. Items without pageviews are left out. Gzip-compressed CSV.

fields.name: QRank
fields.description: Pageviews over the past 52 weeks, summed over all Wikimedia projects

resources.name: item_signals
resources.title: Item signals
resources.description: Ranking signals for Wikidata items, one row per item sorted by item ID, including items without pageviews. Apache Parquet with zstd compression.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Wikidata item ID without its Q prefix, such as 42 for Q42

fields.name: pageviews_52w
fields.description: Pageviews over the past 52 weeks of all pages linked to the item, summed over all Wikimedia projects

fields.name: wikitext_bytes
fields.description: Size in bytes of the wikitext of all pages linked to the item, summed over all Wikimedia projects

fields.name: statement_count
fields.description: Number of statements on the item in Wikidata

fields.name: identifier_count
fields.description: Number of statements on the item whose property is an external identifier

fields.name: sitelink_count
fields.description: Number of sitelinks of the item, such as links to Wikipedia articles

resources.name: stats
resources.title: QRank statistics
resources.description: A sample of the QRank distribution for plotting. Samples holds [Entity, rank, QRank] triples; Median is the index of the median item in Samples.

resources.name: bom
resources.title: CycloneDX 1.7 bill of materials
resources.description: Provenance of the QRank file and the item signals: the versions of the Wikimedia dumps and pageviews, and of every qrank-builder release that processed them.
